cells.gaps: ARTICLE 19 and RSF reported the oversight body closed by the government in August 2025; RSF says the dissolution is not official. No decision of it since 2023 has been found.
cells.note: The government's 2024 return to UNESCO reports 7,347 appeals received by the access-to-information body in 2023, inside three years. That meets the top rung; the body's loss of a quorum in late 2025 is recorded in gaps.
